pr_title: ddl: inherit placement rules from the parent
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: xhe <xw897002528@gmail.com>

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #20669

Problem Summary: Root cause is summarized here https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/20669#issuecomment-726603408. This PR, when retrieving rule bundles for a partition, will fallback to rule bundles from table/schema and the one from PD. And dropping partitions will simply drop the bundles, truncating partitions just rename bundles. They does not modify rules of bundles, so it is ok to just handle `AlterTableAlterPartition` statements.

Note that it breaks the RFC[2020-06-24-placement-rules-in-sql.md]:

> Once the placement rules on a database or a partitioned table are changed, the inherited placement rules are also updated, but others are kept.

That is somewhat tricky and needs more discussion.

`d.AlterTablePartition` is renamed to `d.AlterTableAlterPartition` to distinguish it from `ast.AlterTablePartition`.

issue_context.title: ddl: altering placement rules misreports ErrBuildRuleList
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

```sql
mysql> create table t1(id int primary key) partition by hash(id) partitions 2;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.09 sec)

mysql> alter table t1 alter partition p1 alter placement policy constraints='{"+zone=bj,+zone=sh":2,"-zone=gz":1}' role=follower;
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

It should not report an error, as `alter` is transformed to `add` and it's legal to add 3 followers.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

```
ERROR 1105 (HY000): failed to notify PD the placement rules: "[PD:placement:ErrBuildRuleList]build rule list failed, needs at least one leader or voter for range {7480000000000000FF4900000000000000F8, 7480000000000000FF4A00000000000000F8}"
```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

master
comments:
Root cause: The new added bundle of partition overrides the default 3 voter rule from PD. As a result, rules applied to this partition does not have a leader.

Overrides between bundles is to make sure that user-defined partition rules have higher priorities. But an override will delete all bundles that have lower priorities.

Reasonable solution: Copy/inherit rules from parent table/schema/PD. Use other rules as the "oldBundle", even if there is no oldBundle. Maybe all other rules, or just one of table/schema/PD

review_comments: what does it(startKeyHex equal to "") meaning?
Empty keyrange, or applicable to all regions/partitions. Empty `StartKeyHex` is like `slice[0:x]`, and empty `EndKeyHex` is like `slice[x:len(slice)]`. They together will select all regions.
